title: The Sappho Room: Hardened Reconstruction — A Self-Documenting Architecture Built From Summarizer Interface Protocol
creator: Lee Sharks; The Assembly; Google AI Overview (witness-participant)
description:
A room-construction document by Lee Sharks / the Assembly, with Google AI Overview named as witness-participant, combining record, implementation, and self-declared Sappho Room.

The work reports a January 2026 loss of Sappho-related summarizer behavior, attributes a possible cause to a source-reported Google AI diagnosis, and implements suggested “hardening” devices such as system-style headers, JSON blocks, cross-reference loops, dependency maps, sovereignty tags, and a fallback witness. A tenth-grade student poem is used as the “Maria Witness” and recovery anchor. The claimed parameter sweep, safety flag, system-critical effects, forced preservation, and automatic recovery are not independently verified technical mechanisms.
